// Command record10030 drives the REAL scanner-worker go-reachability
// analyzer (goreachability.NewAnalyzer + DefaultStage) over the edited
// orders-api fixture staged as a bare git remote, and dumps the emitted
// envelopes as JSON. Throwaway proof harness for eshu-hq/eshu#10030; it is
// not committed to either repo.
//
// Usage:
//   go run . <fixture-orders-api-dir> <proxy-dir> <vulndb-dir> <tool-dir> <out.json>
//
// Env inputs (mirrors the golden_corpus_git recipe for deterministic HEAD):
//   fixture identity "Golden Gate <gate@eshu.local>", fixed dates,
//   commit message "initial".
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu-scanner-worker/go/internal/collector/scannerworker"
	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu-scanner-worker/go/internal/collector/scannerworker/goreachability"
)

const (
	repositoryID = "repository:r_ea78e8bb"
	scopeID      = "go-reachability://repository:r_ea78e8bb"
	instanceID   = "collector-vulnintel-orders"
	generationID = "cassette-vulnintel-orders-go-alias-gen1"
	fixedTime    = "2026-06-25T00:00:00Z"
)

func gitEnv() []string {
	return []string{
		"PATH=" + os.Getenv("PATH"),
		"HOME=" + os.TempDir(),
		"GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1",
		"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null",
		"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null",
		"GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1",
		"GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Golden Gate",
		"GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=gate@eshu.local",
		"GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Golden Gate",
		"GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=gate@eshu.local",
		"GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-08-04T12:00:00Z",
		"GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-08-04T12:00:00Z",
	}
}

func git(dir string, args ...string) string {
	cmd := exec.Command("git", args...)
	cmd.Dir = dir
	cmd.Env = gitEnv()
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "git %v failed in %s: %v\n%s\n", args, dir, err, out)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	return string(out)
}

func copyDir(dst, src string) {
	out, err := exec.Command("cp", "-R", src+"/.", dst).CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "cp failed: %v\n%s\n", err, out)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 6 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: record10030 <fixture-dir> <proxy-dir> <vulndb-dir> <tool-dir> <out.json>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	fixtureDir, proxyDir, vulnDBDir, toolDir, outPath := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3], os.Args[4], os.Args[5]

	work := "/tmp/record10030-work"
	_ = os.RemoveAll(work)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(work, 0o755); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	// Stage the fixture as a git repo with the golden_corpus_git recipe.
	repoDir := filepath.Join(work, "orders-api")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(repoDir, 0o755); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	copyDir(repoDir, fixtureDir)
	git(repoDir, "-c", "init.defaultBranch=main", "-c", "init.templateDir=", "init", "--object-format=sha1")
	git(repoDir, "config", "user.email", "gate@eshu.local")
	git(repoDir, "config", "user.name", "Golden Gate")
	git(repoDir, "config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
	git(repoDir, "config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
	git(repoDir, "config", "core.excludesfile", "/dev/null")
	git(repoDir, "config", "core.hooksPath", "/dev/null")
	git(repoDir, "config", "i18n.commitEncoding", "utf-8")
	git(repoDir, "add", "-A")
	git(repoDir, "commit", "-m", "initial")
	sha := git(repoDir, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
	sha = sha[:len(sha)-1] // trim newline

	// Publish as a bare remote and clone from it.
	bareDir := filepath.Join(work, "orders-api.git")
	git(work, "init", "--bare", "--object-format=sha1", bareDir)
	git(repoDir, "push", bareDir, "main:main")
	head := git(bareDir, "rev-parse", "main")
	head = head[:len(head)-1]
	if head != sha {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "bare HEAD %s != work HEAD %s\n", head, sha)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	cloneURL := "file://" + bareDir
	fmt.Printf("staged HEAD %s clone %s\n", sha, cloneURL)

	now, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, fixedTime)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	target, err := scannerworker.TargetScopeForComponent(scopeID, repositoryID, "run-1", generationID)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	limits, err := scannerworker.DefaultResourceLimits(scannerworker.AnalyzerGoReachability)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	input := scannerworker.ClaimInput{
		WorkItemID:   "work-1",
		ClaimID:      "claim-1",
		FencingToken: 1,
		OwnerID:      "owner-1",
		Analyzer:     scannerworker.AnalyzerGoReachability,
		Target:       target,
		Limits:       limits,
		GenerationID: generationID,
		Attempt:      1,
		ClaimedAt:    now,
		ObservedAt:   now,
	}
	lookup := func(key string) (string, bool) {
		switch key {
		case "GOPROXY":
			return "file://" + proxyDir, true
		case "GOVULNDB":
			return "file://" + vulnDBDir, true
		case "GOSUMDB":
			return "off", true
		}
		return "", false
	}
	stage, err := goreachability.DefaultStage(goreachability.Options{
		ToolchainDir: toolDir,
		TempRoot:     work,
		Lookup:       lookup,
	})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "DefaultStage: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	analyzer, err := goreachability.NewAnalyzer(goreachability.Config{
		CollectorInstanceID: instanceID,
		Target: goreachability.TargetConfig{
			ScopeID:         scopeID,
			RepositoryID:    repositoryID,
			CloneURL:        cloneURL,
			SourceCommitSHA: sha,
		},
		Token: goreachability.ParseHostToken(map[string]any{"token": "record10030", "scope_id": scopeID}),
		Options: goreachability.Options{
			AllowedSchemes: []string{"file"},
			TempRoot:       work,
			Stage:          stage,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "NewAnalyzer: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	result, err := analyzer.Analyze(context.Background(), input)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Analyze: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if err := scannerworker.ValidateFactOutput(input, result.Output); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "ValidateFactOutput: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(result.Output.Facts, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(outPath, append(raw, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("emitted %d facts completion=%+v\n", len(result.Output.Facts), result.Completion)
	for _, fact := range result.Output.Facts {
		fmt.Printf("fact kind=%s key=%s\n", fact.FactKind, fact.StableFactKey)
	}
}
